title: Can we use the HierarchicalMenu from an inner page?
body: The hierarchicalMenu from an inner page gives a category url which is relative to the current page instead of the homepage. Those links obviously do not work. Can the hierarchicalMenu be placed on an inner page?

comments.body: Did you try the `rootLevel` option? If I understand your problem correctly, that's the problem you're facing. Feel free to give more information to give a clearer view of the problem at stake though

rootLevel I understand is to do with the hierachicalLevel rendering. My issue as follows.
I have an implementation of instant search on the home page. A hierarchicalMenu with two levels which aggregates the total number of results and links pointing to the respective aggregated results is present on the homepage. On this page, the instantsearch works as expected.
 i.e. If http://example.com is the home page, the aggregated results links are like http://example.com/q?=queryString which works fine. 
However, the hierarchicalMenu implemented from an inner page, say http://example.com/inner-page, the hierarchicalMenu links are now relative to this inner page like so, http://example.com/inner-page?q=queryString which obviously doesn’t give any results.
Is there any way that from an inner page, the menu links are still relative to the home page.

You can use `transformData.item` to change the URL to one relative to the correct page. See [the docs](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/hierarchicalMenu.html#struct-HierarchicalMenuTransforms) for that. 

Basically it's a function which will give you an `item` object (including `url`), and you should return a new `item` object, but you can change everything on it, like the `url` here.
Couldn't figure it out. Wish there was more info in the documentation.
Are you using the routing system? @netscasy

@bobylito Laravel routing is used. Tried getting a redirect from the controller, grabbing the query string. But the hierarchicalMenu links when clicked doesn't get propagated as an HTTP request, even though the link shows up in the address bar.
Would it be possible to create a reproduction with both of the routing systems in place? That would help in debugging
@netscasy can you provide us a way to see a reproduction of this issue in a live environment? Otherwise we won't be able to address it.
